title: SortuInvocation_v13
description: Input contract for a SORTU-Ω v13.0.0 x1000 Centuria Forge invocation.

intent.description: Natural language description of the skill to forge. Minimum 8 characters to prevent trivial intents.

skill_name.description: Target skill name. Used for VSA anchoring and ledger persistence.

causal_parent.description: UUID of the parent skill or decision in the causal DAG. Null for root-level skills.

requested_by.description: Identifier of the agent or user requesting the forge.

overlap_threshold.description: Cosine similarity threshold above which a new skill is considered redundant against existing skills.

ttl_days.description: Time-to-live in days before the skill enters quarantine if unprofitable.

max_unprofitable_invocations.description: Maximum invocations without positive net exergy before quarantine trigger.

force_remote.description: If true, skip local model and use remote frontier model with confidence penalty.

causal_gap_threshold.description: Minimum causal gap score below which a new skill is considered fully covered by existing skills.

target_languages.description: Programming languages the forged skill should target. Empty means language-agnostic.

hours_saved.description: Estimated linear hours saved per invocation. Used in compound yield calculation.

dependency_depth.description: Chain depth from causal DAG. Higher depth = higher compound yield multiplier.

complexity.description: Skill complexity estimate [0.0, 1.0]. Used for Lyapunov entropy impact prediction.

centuria_mode.description: If true, deploy 200-thread Centuria saturated forge instead of sequential pipeline.

recombine_genes.description: List of genome gene names to fuse via VSA superposition into a hybrid skill.

silicon_eval.description: If true, evaluate Direct-Silicon JIT viability score (Ω₀).

death_protocol.description: If true, activate automated Death Protocol (exergy-negative purge and quarantine).

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata attached to the forge invocation.
